definitions.explanation: Activities done for enjoyment and pleasure.

examples.japanese: {映画|えいが}は{人気|にんき}のある{娯楽|ごらく}だ。
examples.english: Movies are a popular form of entertainment.

examples.japanese: {娯楽|ごらく}{施設|しせつ}がたくさんある。
{仕事|しごと}ばかりで{娯楽|ごらく}の{時間|じかん}がない。
examples.english: I only work and have no time for recreation.

notes:
{娯楽|ごらく} refers to entertainment or recreational activities done for pleasure.

Common collocations:
- {娯楽|ごらく}{施設|しせつ} (entertainment facility)
- {娯楽|ごらく}{産業|さんぎょう} (entertainment industry)
- {娯楽|ごらく}{番組|ばんぐみ} (entertainment program)
- {娯楽|ごらく}{映画|えいが} (entertainment film)

Similar words:
- エンターテインメント (entertainment - loanword)
- {趣味|しゅみ} (hobby - more personal)
- {レジャー} (leisure activities)
- {遊|あそ}び (play, fun - more casual)
